relationships.subject: TLR4
relationships.evidence_quote: TLR4 plays a critical role in K/BxN ST nociceptive mechanisms since both TLR4 knock-out mice and intrathecal injection of TLR4 antagonists are associated with reversal of K/BxN ST allodynia

relationships.subject: Galectin-3
relationships.evidence_quote: Gal-3 is normally expressed at low levels by microglia in homoeostasis and promotes cytokine release through activation of microglial TLR4 in various neurological disorders

relationships.subject: Galectin-3
relationships.evidence_quote: Gal-3 is upregulated in disease-associated microglia in neurological disorders43–45 and binds microglial TREM246

relationships.subject: Dorsal horn microglia
relationships.evidence_quote: In WT microglia (CD45low CD11b+ CX3CR1+ cells), we observed a higher proportion of TLR4+ cells and higher TLR4 expression at the single-cell level in K/BxN ST compared to control ST

key_findings: In WT mice, inflammatory allodynia involves upregulated microglial TLR4 and dorsal horn Gal-3 release from afferents; Gal-3 inhibition attenuates allodynia.
TASTPM (AD model) mice have reduced allodynia, TREM2-high microglia and a P2Y12- TLR4- subset insensitive to Gal-3 inhibition.
